features.title: Built tough for everyday office life, Core ensures teams stay organized with quick, reliable access and provides performance in busy team zones.
Engineered with a steel frame and tempered glass, Core balances toughness with transparent convenience. It offers strength, visibility, and easy access for everyday use.
Quiet, smooth operation from soft-close hinges brings both convenience and elegance to everyday storage.
Compact design integrates into team areas, corridors, or breakout zones, providing flexible shared storage anywhere it’s needed.
Hinged doors with cam locks safeguard belongings, ensuring reliable storage even in shared, high-traffic zones.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
